title: Netflix TV v1.4.3
changelog: Eliminated CTV video ads on Android TV by standardizing Desktop Chrome User-Agent across devices
Fixed Next.js SSR hydration exception on AutoEmbed server
Removed false-positive disable-devtool dead-stream trigger causing rapid server cycling
Added instant audio muting and hardware-safe auto-skip for pre-roll video ads
Enhanced FrameX backup player stability and suppressed floating gift badges
